appraisal_events.evidence: elle se livrait à la place à une mimique conventionnelle qui signifiait, sans fatigue ni risques pour elle, qu'elle riait aux larmes
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator shows Mme Verdurin sustaining her role as the salon's animating hostess through a practiced, effortless performance of hilarity, letting her command the room's mood without real exertion; the portrait is comic and mocking even as it depicts her local success.

appraisal_events.evidence: M. Verdurin, après avoir demandé à Swann la permission d'allumer sa pipe (« ici on ne se gêne pas, on est entre camarades »)
appraisal_events.explanation: M. Verdurin's small deferential gesture and his framing of the circle as one of equals ('entre camarades') mark Swann as an at-ease, welcomed member of the group rather than a formal outsider.

status_effects.explanation: Her risk-free, practiced mirth lets her keep effectively animating the salon from her elevated seat, a local rhetorical success even though the description is ironic.
Swann is treated as a full, comfortable member of the Verdurin circle, informally welcomed rather than held at a distance.

ambiguities: Mme Verdurin's local 'success' in commanding the room is bound up with a comic, mocking portrait of her performed laughter, so the elevation is read cautiously rather than as unambiguous narrator endorsement.
Swann's inclusion here rests on a brief, conventional courtesy (permission to smoke, a remark about camaraderie); it is minor and could plausibly be read as too slight to score.
